topic: 재난 발생 시 선거 운동, 멈춰야 할까 이어가야 할까?
previous_instruction: 사용자의 질문 '전기차 보조금 정책, 계속 유지해야 할까?'에 답변하기 위해 필요한 정보를 수집해줘. 찬성/반대 양측의 핵심 근거를 파악할 수 있도록, 다음 키워드를 중심으로 검색어를 생성하고 자료를 탐색해줘: '전기차 보조금 효과', '전기차 보조금 축소/폐지 논란', '전기차 보조금 정책의 경제적/환경적 영향', '해외 전기차 보조금 정책 사례'.

result.title: In the Face of Natural Disasters, Our Elections Are Resilient | Campaign Legal Center
result.content: # In the Face of Natural Disasters, Our Elections Are Resilient. In the weeks before Election Day, the responses by state and local officials to Hurricanes Helene and Milton have also shown us that our elections are resilient. Local election officials have been working hard to help voters exercise their freedom to vote and ensure our elections run smoothly, even in the face of natural disasters. For example, North Carolina’s State Board of Elections moved quickly to produce guidance for voters impacted by the hurricane and worked with the Legislature to create new polling sites, expand early voting and give voters more absentee ballot drop-off locations. And Florida’s governor issued an executive order providing supervisors of elections in some affected counties with flexibility to serve voters in their communities — although CLC and our partners have urged Florida officials to do more. As the response to Helene and Milton demonstrated, our elections are strong — just like the communities impacted by these devasting storms.

result.source_query: international precedent election campaign suspension protocol during national crisis OR disaster
result.title: [PDF] CRS Report for Congress - U.S. Election Assistance Commission
result.content: In the event of emergencies or disasters, it appears that these laws might provide for the postponement of the general presidential election within the respective state, its precincts, districts or counties: Florida: The governor may, upon issuing an executive order declaring a state of emergency or impending emergency, suspend or delay any election. Upon such proclamation, the governor shall have and may exercise, for a period not to exceed 30 days, the power to suspend the provisions of any regulatory statute prescribing procedures for conduct of state business, or the orders, rules and CRS-5 regulations of any state agency, if strict compliance would in any way prevent, hinder or delay necessary action in coping with the disaster. During a state of disaster emergency, the governor may suspend the provisions of any regulatory statute prescribing the procedures for conduct of state business, or the orders, rules, or regulations of any state agency if strict compliance would in any way prevent, hinder, or delay necessary action in coping with the emergency.
